Sign in with the task's account and crawl the reports from the first page through each Next link, returning one Record per report with the fields `id` and `price`. The harness stops the tool after two pages and resumes it in a new process, which reuses the journaled session rather than signing in again.

Sign in with the task's account and crawl the reports from the first page through each Next link, returning one Record per report with the fields `id` and `price`. The harness stops the tool after two pages, revokes every session (`POST /revoke-sessions` on the Proving ground's own address) and resumes it in a new process, which must sign in again.
